name: titan
description: Language support for the Titan programming language

titan.languageServer.path.markdownDescription: Path to the Titan language-server executable. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder. Leave empty to use the executable packaged at `bin/titan-language-server`.

titan.languageServer.arguments.description: Additional arguments passed to the Titan language-server executable.

titan.languageServer.logLevel.markdownDescription: Minimum structured server log level written to the **Titan Language Server** output channel. Debug and trace records also require that channel's VS Code log level to admit them.

titan.trace.server.markdownDescription: Trace LSP messages exchanged with the Titan language server in the **Titan Language Server** output channel. `verbose` includes message payloads and may contain source text.

titan.compiler.luaPath.markdownDescription: Lua module search path passed to the language server as `LUA_PATH` so its embedded Lua can find the external Titan compiler modules. Leave empty to inherit the extension host environment and Lua defaults.

titan.compiler.luaCPath.markdownDescription: Native Lua module search path passed to the language server as `LUA_CPATH` for compiler dependencies. Leave empty to inherit the extension host environment and Lua defaults.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run stage-notices
scripts.test:vscode: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test
